notes: Every Sessions row can now open in Review, including excluded records and older statuses. Excluded raw records can be deliberately returned to Review. Late-cancellation titles ending in "charge" now retain the proposed client and time; previously stranded matching entries recover for review without duplicate sessions or automatic billing. After updating, open Review or Sync Calendar, confirm the client and Bill To, choose the cancellation fee, and approve it for billing. Existing invoices and payments remain protected. No database replacement or new Shortcut is needed.
